title: Our Flat
text:
This is our flat. It has two bedrooms and a big kitchen. In the kitchen there is a table and four chairs. The table is white.

My sister's room is small. It has a bed, a desk and a bookcase. Her books are on the bookcase. I like the yellow curtains in her room.

questions.text: How many bedrooms does the flat have?
Where does the writer's sister probably study?
What can we guess about the writer's sister?

vocabulary.definition: a room where food is prepared and cooked
a piece of furniture with shelves for books
pieces of cloth hung at a window to cover it
a table used for reading, writing or studying

paragraph_translations: Bu bizim dairemiz. İki yatak odası ve büyük bir mutfağı var. Mutfakta bir masa ve dört sandalye var. Masa beyaz.
Kız kardeşimin odası küçük. Bir yatağı, bir çalışma masası ve bir kitaplığı var. Kitapları kitaplıkta. Odasındaki sarı perdeleri seviyorum.
